facts.fact: Mobile money usage in Zambia is 76.2% per the 2025 FinScope survey, and mobile money operators connect to the National Financial Switch.
The National Financial Switch supports wallet-to-bank and bank-to-wallet transfers as well as merchant payments, per ITWeb quoting a Sybrin manager.
The National Financial Switch connects banks, non-bank financial institutions, payment service providers, fintechs and mobile money operators, per ITWeb quoting a Sybrin manager.
